mutants.description: fault_arbiter's current flag is qualified by the modulator PWM, as if the current comparator were only valid during high-side on-time, though it is a valley comparator sampled in low-side conduction
mutants.reason: fault_arbiter's sample at pwm_rise reads the comparator from BLANK_CLKS clocks before turn-on, when PWM is low. So every sample is 0, and a sustained CP_trig in S_SS or S_RUN never trips a window or sends the converter into hiccup.

mutants.description: fault_cause's 'converter running' capture scope also covers S_HICCUP, as if the hiccup cool-down were part of the operating episode
mutants.reason: latch_assert rises one clock after S_HICCUP is entered on the final strike, and OTP/UVLO can assert during the cool-down. With this edit those are logged in FAULT_CAUSE (BIT_LATCH, BIT_OTP, BIT_UVLO) with a fault_time, where the design leaves them out because the converter is stopped.

mutants.description: reg_file's enable-switch status bit reports the combined enable (switch AND host CONTROL enable) instead of the physical switch alone
mutants.reason: After the host disables the converter over SPI (keyed disable) with the switch still on, STATUS bit 4 reads 0 instead of 1. The host can then no longer tell its own veto from the switch being off.

mutants.description: reg_file's SCR latch status bit shows only externally-originated latch trips, masking the read-back whenever the CPLD's own latch_out is driving, as if it were fault_cause's OVP inference
mutants.reason: After a strike latch (latch_out high) with the SCR read back set, STATUS bit 3 reads 0 instead of 1. It only reports the latch when it is tripped by the analog side.
